annotation: Firmware fact: ADC sample at 0xfffff80c (reference register label ADDR6H_B; inspect mov.w width) is copied to RAM 0xffff9ef0. Candidate APV feedback chain, via 0x43a86. Harness APV signal is PCM 3B (13Electrical.pdf p16); MCU-to-connector link is not electrically verified.
Firmware fact: alternate ADC acquisition also writes RAM 0xffff9ef0 from register 0xfffff80c. Candidate APV input; the hardware diagram does not itself assign ADC channels.

Candidate APV software-PWM service. Firmware fact: drives PLDR_W 0xfffff75e masks 0x0020/0x0100 (PL5 pkg pin 221 / PL8 pkg pin 224) with opposite polarity from pending ticks 0xffffa1c4/a1c6. pinout v3: APV motor control (-) at PCM 3J wire L/R (confirmed), (+) at PCM 3G wire G/B (³) (HP ³); per-bit-to-terminal polarity still unverified.

Candidate APV signed duty splitter. Firmware fact: period u16 at ROM 0x78bb6 (96); forward/reverse ticks -> 0xffffa1c4/a1c6. pinout v3: APV motor wires PCM 3J/3G (HP ³), colours L/R / R/W (*). See reconstructed/rx8_apv.c.

Candidate APV drive-status sampler. Firmware fact: reads PHDR_W 0x1000/0x2000 (PH12/PH13, pkg pins 79/80). pinout v3: APV opening-angle signal at PCM 3B (wire R/G, HP ³) and position-sensor power at PCM 1S (B/W *); external meaning of the two PH inputs not established.
Candidate APV command wrapper. Firmware fact: float 0xffffbf84 negated when 0xffffbf8b==1, /100 -> 0xaa90. pinout v3: APV motor 3J/3G (HP ³).

Candidate APV control wrapper (0x31c6c/0x31ece/0x31f0a/0x31f32/0x31bec). pinout v3: APV motor 3J/3G, signal 3B, power 1S, return 1U (all HP ³); colours L/R, G/B, R/G, R/W. Electrical proof still absent.

Firmware fact: ADC6 raw 0xffff9ef0 * 5/65536 -> float 0xffffcab0. pinout v3: APV opening-angle signal at PCM 3B (wire R/G, HP ³) — candidate APV feedback; PCM 3B -> AN6 (pkg pin 92) not board-verified. See reconstructed/rx8_apv.c.
Candidate APV feedback-range logic on 0xffffcab0. pinout v3: APV position sensor power PCM 1S (R/W), return 1U (BR).

Candidate SSV control. Firmware fact: writes mask 0x0080 of 0xfffff754 (PEDR_W, PE7 = SH7055F pkg pin 16) via 0x4bbc after diagnostic arbitration. Pinout v3 (mazda-rx-8-pcm-pinout-series-1.pdf, 2026-10-30): SSV solenoid control at PCM 1L, wire L/Y (confirmed); SSV position switch at PCM 1D, wire L (confirmed). Chip-pin -> terminal routing still board-level unresolved.

Candidate VDI control. Firmware fact: writes mask 0x0020 of 0xfffff746 (PDDR_W, PD5 = pkg pin 254) after hysteresis and diagnostic override. pinout v3: VDI solenoid control at PCM 1W, wire L/B (confirmed). Chip-pin -> terminal routing still board-level unresolved.

Harness context (pinout v3, 2026-10-30): six injector control wires with colours — 2M Front Primary 1 LG/R, 2J Rear Primary 1 LG/B, 2G Front Secondary G/R, 2D Rear Secondary L/B, 3A Front Primary 2 L/B (HP ³), 3D Rear Primary 2 W/G (HP ³); each injector also has a shared W/L +12V power feed (PCM switches the low side via TO8A-F, pkg pins 195/197-201). Firmware array indices have not been assigned to these terminals (board routing unresolved).

Harness context: diagram p10 identifies four ignition trigger wires: leading front 2AA, trailing front 2AD, leading rear 2Z, trailing rear 2AC. Firmware output/channel ordering is not confirmed by the diagram.

Harness context: metering oil pump uses four control wires PCM 2W/2V/2AB/2Y (p14). Its separate switch at PCM 2N (pp16-17) indicates fully-open stepping-motor position during learning; it is distinct from oil pressure and oil level switches. Exact firmware phase-to-pin mapping remains unverified.

Harness context: oil pressure switch is PCM 2E and closes on low pressure (pp18-19); oil level switch is separate at PCM 2R. This inherited oil-pressure status name is not proof that the underlying input bit has been traced to PCM 2E.

Harness context: manual-transmission neutral switch is PCM 2O and opens in neutral (pp18-19). Brake switch is PCM 4P (p10). Input electrical polarity at the MCU and the interpretation of internal flags remain unverified.

Candidate VFAD control. Firmware fact: writes mask 0x0400 of 0xfffff754 (PEDR_W, PE10 = pkg pin 19). pinout v3: VFAD control at PCM 5Z (high-power only ³), wire colour not legible (–). Chip-pin -> terminal routing still board-level unresolved.
Secondary-air injection solenoid control. Firmware fact: writes PEDR_W mask 0x0100 (PE8 = pkg pin 17) from the diag-checked request. pinout v3: AIR control at PCM 1O, wire G (confirmed).

Secondary-air pump drive output. Firmware fact: writes PBDR_W mask 0x4 (PB2 = pkg pin 147) = secondary_air_pump_request (0xffffbf6c). pinout v3 has no dedicated pump-control terminal listed; supply side not traced.
